comment: Three sweeps read the Brush Presets grid as one glyph, as blank tiles over Stamp, and as strokes too small to read at 72 by 36. A fresh profile opens the docker where the shipped layout puts it, at 310 by 370, and its cells are now 112 wide, near the 128 by 64 each preset's own stroke is rendered at, so the default docker holds two columns. With the Brush on a stamp preset the stamp tiles carry no engine line and the noise tiles say Noise. A noise preset loaded from the docker turns the Brush to its noise engine, and the lines move: the stamp tiles say Stamp and the noise tiles none. The docker's dump holds the cell size and the column count, and the engines dump holds each cell's line and its tooltip, which still names the engine on every tile and on the Eraser says why its picture is empty. look reads the document and not a docker, so it is used on a stroke painted with the preset each half picked.
